title: EPOC ellipsoidal state-specific solvent response
summary: Converge electronic density and fast/slow continuum response with an explicit backend, level and Gaussian basis. Installed JSON adapter: PySCF RHF/RKS equilibrium ground states. Excited owners supply certified state continuity through the method-independent iteration API.
gates: explicit backend, method, basis, solvent dielectrics and fixed Cartesian cavity
no mandatory FCI; PySCF RHF/RKS adapter with explicit XC functional for RKS; unsupported combinations rejected
Gaussian AO moments through spectral degree 2 in the exact translated/rotated modal frame
converged inner electronic solver; maximum AO density residual <1e-9 and energy change <1e-11 hartree
independent final fixed-point density residual <1e-9; independent vacuum expectation error <1e-10 hartree
electronic density outside cavity <1e-5 electrons on an independent level-4 quadrature grid
initial slow field frozen during vertical transitions; excited-owner continuity certificate and overlap >=0.9
remove Tr(D V_reaction) before adding polarization free energy and slow preparation cost
explicit authorization; one process, one thread, 1 GB envelope, 512 MB PySCF setting, <=80 AOs, <=240 outer iterations
fixed molecular geometry and cavity; no general excited-state backend qualification inferred from small FCI reference
coordinate_policy: Fixed Cartesian molecule/cavity; exact translated/rotated analytic Gaussian modal moments through degree 2. No geometry optimization or cavity relaxation.
backend_policy: Backend, level and basis are explicit inputs. JSON adapter executes PySCF RHF or RKS closed-shell equilibrium ground states. Other methods and excited states require an electronic owner returning converged total state density, vacuum Hamiltonian expectation and excited-state continuity. FCI/STO-3G is an optional reference test, never a default requirement.
